program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((positions2 (list (list 0 0) (list 0 1) (list 1 0) (list 1 1)))
                  (t-order (list 0 1 2 3 4 5 6 7)))
             (define (zero-row? r)
               (all? (lambda (c) (zero? (at g r c))) (range 0 (cols g))))
             (define (group-start r) (if (or (zero? r) (zero-row? (- r 1))) r (- r 1)))
             (define (src t r c)
               (cond
                 ((zero? t) (list r c))
                 ((= t 1) (list r (- 1 c)))
                 ((= t 2) (list (- 1 r) c))
                 ((= t 3) (list (- 1 r) (- 1 c)))
                 ((= t 4) (list (- 1 c) r))
                 ((= t 5) (list c (- 1 r)))
                 ((= t 6) (list c r))
                 (else (list (- 1 c) (- 1 r)))))
             (define (block-val gr base r c) (at g (+ gr r) (+ base c)))
             (define (a-val gr t r c)
               (let ((p (src t r c))) (block-val gr 0 (fst p) (snd p))))
             (define (b-val gr r c) (block-val gr 3 r c))
             (define (c-val gr t r c)
               (let ((p (src t r c))) (block-val gr 7 (fst p) (snd p))))
             (define (consistent? gr t)
               (all? (lambda (p)
                       (all? (lambda (q)
                               (or
                                 (!= (a-val gr t (fst p) (snd p))
                                     (a-val gr t (fst q) (snd q)))
                                 (= (b-val gr (fst p) (snd p))
                                    (b-val gr (fst q) (snd q)))))
                             positions2))
                     positions2))
             (define (exact-score gr t)
               (count-if (lambda (p)
                           (= (a-val gr t (fst p) (snd p)) (b-val gr (fst p) (snd p))))
                         positions2))
             (define (mapping gr t v)
               (let ((hits (filter (lambda (p) (= (a-val gr t (fst p) (snd p)) v))
                                   positions2)))
                 (if (null? hits) #f (b-val gr (fst (first hits)) (snd (first hits))))))
             (define (best-t gr)
               (first (sort (filter (lambda (t) (consistent? gr t)) t-order)
                            (lambda (a b)
                              (let ((sa (exact-score gr a))
                                    (sb (exact-score gr b)))
                                (or (> sa sb) (and (= sa sb) (< a b))))))))
             (build-grid h
                         2
                         (r c)
                         (if (zero-row? r)
                             0
                             (let* ((gr (group-start r))
                                    (lr (- r gr))
                                    (t (best-t gr))
                                    (v (c-val gr t lr c))
                                    (m (mapping gr t v)))
                               (if m m v))))))))
